userDirection: Thicken the small circular skill frames and refine their construction and decoration while retaining the current gold brightness.
ownership: Project-original deterministic SVG refinement of unified-gold-skill-v13. No generation or external downloads.
construction: Outer raised lip, two narrow chased channels, recessed inner seam and return lip. The wider metal face leaves space for four native twin-leaf scroll groups. Floral scrolls remain native UiChrome paths, not baked into this bitmap.

artReview.isolated: Inspected direct-vector 120 px / 64 px comparison after expanding total bezel to33.425 source px; the thicker construction is distinct from v13 and preserves the gold palette and silhouette.
artReview.runtime: Inspected actual desktop DPR2, mobile844x390 and narrow667x375 captures. Thick layered bezel and four axis-aligned paired-leaf engravings remain clear of icons, hotkeys and rank badges; neutral-gold palette retained. Small-size texture aliasing resolved with mipmapped non-atlased skill frame.

sampling.filter: Trilinear mipmaps, 10 levels; separate non-packable SpriteFrame for skill-v14 only.
sampling.reason: Keep fine metal channels smooth at native 52/58/86 logical-pixel controls and mobile CSS sizes.
sampling.source: UiSkin.ts plus Cocos-generated PNG meta with mipfilter linear and genMipmaps true.
